card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: Middle or ending pieces of long medical words, such as 'intra-abdom|inal', 'post|traumatic' and 'inhal|ation', mostly in clinical or injury text. It also fires on a few linking words like 'along' before 'with'.

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: Fires on the piece in the middle or end of a long clinical word that is still unfinished or just finished.

modes.label: Trauma and poisoning terms
modes.description: Fires on pieces of words about injury, poisoning or fractures.

modes.label: Linking word in a care list
modes.description: Fires on 'along' in a phrase that adds general supportive care.
modes.example: vital sign monitoring are recommended,<< along>> with general symptomatic and supportive care.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a long medical word, such as intra-abdominal or posttraumatic, where the word is not finished yet.
